daily_thesis: The 11 September U.S. session rebounded as oil retreated from a weekly surge and investors absorbed August CPI, but elevated Treasury daily par yields and a narrow multi-day sector-proxy backdrop keep valuation sensitivity high. Oracle provides official AI-infrastructure demand evidence; NVIDIA–Anthropic and AI-lab pacing developments remain conditional reported items. The next validation is whether policy communication, energy risk and completed-market breadth align rather than one headline dominating the tape.
